memory.you/units-in-answers.md:
---
type: Concept
title: Units in answers
---

They want every quantity in an answer given in SI units as well as in the simulation's own units (G = 1), in that order.

**Why:** they compare against papers that use SI.

**When it applies:** any answer with a number in it.

turn.asked: What time step does the leapfrog note suggest? Give it the way I like numbers given.
